snippet.title: Graytail - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description:
A small island in the Pacific. The greatest female pilot has vanished. Suffering from severe headaches, our protagonist depends on medication as they search for her, but... What is real and what is hallucination? A Zelda-like mystery adventure to uncover the island's truth.
Head over to Steam and add Graytail to your Wishlist.
